equipmentRule: requiredEquipment must all be in the athlete's equipment; when anyOfEquipment is present, at least one of it must be too. Exercise names are exact: use only the keys below.

pullUps.use: negativePullUp (3-5 s lowering, 3-5 reps), bandAssistedPullUp when a resistance band is available, invertedRow for pulling volume, scapularPull and deadHang as support; full pullUp only as singles inside the working cap.
submaximal pullUp sets inside the working cap as the main work, negativePullUp as a finisher, invertedRow or bandAssistedPullUp for extra volume.
pullUp volume sets; archerPullUp or lSitPullUp in small doses for technique and strength.
keep one pullUp volume day for the goal and add strength work: weightedPullUp (with dumbbells or a loaded backpack), archerPullUp or lSitPullUp.

pushUps.use: inclinePushUp and kneePushUp for volume; full pushUp in small sets inside the working cap.
full pushUp sets as the main work; inclinePushUp for extra volume.
full pushUp sets; diamondPushUp or declinePushUp for variation and triceps or shoulder strength; pikePushUp as support.
keep one high-rep pushUp day for the goal and add harder variants instead of ever more reps: declinePushUp, deficitPushUp, archerPushUp, or weightedPushUp with a loaded backpack.

plankSeconds.use: short plank holds (15-20 s) and hollowHold regressions.
plank holds inside the working cap; sidePlank for lateral core.
harder variants instead of longer holds: longLeverPlank, rkcPlank, weightedPlank (loaded backpack); keep one plank hold a week for the goal.

pullUp.title: Pull-up
pullUp.formStandard: Dead hang start, chin over bar, no kipping, controlled lower.

negativePullUp.title: Negative pull-up
negativePullUp.formStandard: Jump or step to chin over bar, lower under control for 3-5 seconds to a full hang.

bandAssistedPullUp.title: Band-assisted pull-up
bandAssistedPullUp.formStandard: Band looped over the bar under a knee or foot; strict pull-up form, full range.

invertedRow.title: Inverted row
invertedRow.formStandard: Under a low bar or a sturdy table edge, body straight, pull the chest to the bar, lower under control.

scapularPull.title: Scapular pull
scapularPull.formStandard: Arms straight, shoulder blades move without elbow bend.

deadHang.title: Dead hang
deadHang.formStandard: Full hang with controlled shoulders and no swinging.

archerPullUp.title: Archer pull-up
archerPullUp.formStandard: Wide grip, pull toward one hand while the other arm stays nearly straight; alternate sides.

lSitPullUp.title: L-sit pull-up
lSitPullUp.formStandard: Legs held straight out in an L for the whole rep, strict pull-up, no swing.

weightedPullUp.title: Weighted pull-up
weightedPullUp.formStandard: Strict pull-up with a dumbbell between the feet or a loaded backpack; name the load in intensity.

pushUp.title: Push-up
pushUp.formStandard: Locked plank body line, controlled depth, full elbow extension.

inclinePushUp.title: Incline push-up
inclinePushUp.formStandard: Strict push-up line with hands elevated.

kneePushUp.title: Knee push-up
kneePushUp.formStandard: Knees down, straight line from knees to shoulders, chest to the floor, full lockout.

pikePushUp.title: Pike push-up
pikePushUp.formStandard: Hips high, controlled press, head moves toward floor.

diamondPushUp.title: Diamond push-up
diamondPushUp.formStandard: Hands together under the chest, elbows close to the body, full range.

declinePushUp.title: Decline push-up
declinePushUp.formStandard: Feet raised on a step or bench, body straight, chest to the floor.

deficitPushUp.title: Deficit push-up
deficitPushUp.formStandard: Hands on two raised surfaces (books, parallettes), chest below hand level, controlled.

archerPushUp.title: Archer push-up
archerPushUp.formStandard: Wide hands, lower toward one hand while the other arm stays straight; alternate sides.

weightedPushUp.title: Weighted push-up
weightedPushUp.formStandard: Strict push-up wearing a loaded backpack; name the load in intensity.

plank.title: Plank
plank.formStandard: Straight body line, no sagging hips, steady breathing.

sidePlank.title: Side plank
sidePlank.formStandard: On one forearm, hips high, body in one line; hold each side for the prescribed seconds.

longLeverPlank.title: Long-lever plank
longLeverPlank.formStandard: Forearms placed ahead of the shoulders (or hands far forward), ribs down, glutes tight.

rkcPlank.title: RKC plank
rkcPlank.formStandard: Maximal-tension plank: elbows pulled toward the toes, glutes and quads squeezed; short holds (10-20 s).

weightedPlank.title: Weighted plank
weightedPlank.formStandard: Strict plank with a loaded backpack or a dumbbell resting on the upper back; name the load in intensity.

hollowHold.title: Hollow hold
hollowHold.formStandard: Low back pressed down, ribs tucked, controlled breathing.

shoulderMobility.title: Shoulder mobility
shoulderMobility.formStandard: Pain-free range, controlled movement, no forcing.
